svg.aria-label: How T3 Code and Claude Code work together. In T3 Code I write an intention in a thread. Each thread runs its own Claude Code agent in its own git worktree: Fable 5.2 on the game, Opus 5.5 on the film, Haiku 5.5 on the chores. The agents use the shell, a browser preview where they play the game, look and fix, and skills such as pxl, chirp and better-star. Everything lands in git, 100 commits, then on Vercel.
svg.title: L’atelier : T3 Code et Claude Code

g.text: UN THREAD · UN AGENT · UN WORKTREE
